title: The time resolution of pcapng is specified by if_tsresol per interface
summary: if_tsresol When the high bit is 0, the unit is the negative power of 10, when the high bit is 1, the unit is the negative power of 2; if not provided, the default is microseconds.
applies: pcapng v1; Section Header, Interface Description and Enhanced Packet Block
detail: 0x09 means 10⁻⁹ seconds, 0x8a means 2⁻¹⁰ seconds. The high and low time fields of the Enhanced Packet Block are combined into a count value.
boundary: The high and low fields are not split into seconds and microseconds; the optional if_tsoffset should also be considered when crossing interfaces.
relevance: Align the timelines of two different acquisition interfaces in the same file.
